Let \(D\) denote a dark square and \(W\) a white square. The original board is

\[
\begin{array}{cccc}
D&W&D&W\\
W&D&D&W\\
D&D&D&W\\
D&W&D&W
\end{array}
\]

After a \(90^\circ\) clockwise turn, the rows become columns, giving

\[
\begin{array}{cccc}
D&D&W&D\\
W&D&D&W\\
D&D&D&D\\
W&W&W&W
\end{array}
\]

In particular, the completely white right-hand column becomes the completely white bottom row. This arrangement matches choice \(C\).
